listed.text: Trunk and Roots: part: the first axis: the seedling's shoot, grown on each year from its terminal bud; age at height: 1 year at 0.46 m, 3 years at 1.77 m, 6 years at 3.87 m (planted trees, DEF site, 10 x 10 ft spacing, not open-grown); part: the structural roots that flare from the trunk base into the soil; structural roots at the trunk base: 4

Leaders: part: the axes of order 1, which carry the crown's main limbs; terminal bud: present: each axis grows on from its own top bud, so the tree keeps one central leader; apical control: 0.50: the share of the resource a main axis keeps over its side shoots (the lambda of the extended Borchert-Honda model). No source gives it; fitted to the spread range on seeds 1 to 4 at the kit's alpha. A value of 0.54, fitted with an alpha of 18, grows a tree too tall here

Branches: part: the axes of order 2; angle from the parent: 40 to 50 degrees. an assumed value; no source opened for it: the beech and ash medians stand in; gravity set-point angle: 180 degrees from gravity (straight up) for the trunk, 135 for its branches, 125 for the rest. an assumed value; no source opened for it, 180 minus the beech and ash zenith angles
Twigs: part: the axes of order 3; tip radius: 0.004 m at every shoot tip; the pipe model sums the tips down to the trunk
Shoots: part: the axes of order 4 and over; internode length: 0.05 m. an assumed value; no source opened for it

leaves, shade Leaf: leaves on the current year: 1: a deciduous tree carries leaves only on the current year's shoots; arrangement: spiral, 137.5 degrees from one leaf to the next; leaves at a node: 1; blade angle beta: a=6.1932, b=1.8352 on t = 2 theta / pi (numpy order): a mean of 69.4 deg from horizontal, SD 12.6; blade outline: a five-pointed star in blade lengths, the lobes as long as the blade is wide; drawn for this bar; blade length: 0.10 to 0.15 m. The source gives the width; the length is taken equal to it (a star leaf is about as long as wide); petiole length: 0.6 of the blade length (sweetgum petioles are long). an assumed value; no source opened for it

Sweetgum.done: At the page camera the tree reads as one straight central leader with an open, narrow crown of star leaves, taller than wide, over a short flare into the soil. Every limb sits on its parent and every leaf on its shoot.

view.why: in the bar scene a viewer stands about one tree height away, the nearest distance at which the whole 3.9 m tree fits in view
view.farthest_why: the full tree hands over to Sweetgum_Lite where a backdrop row begins, about four tree heights, 15 m (the README's Viewing distance), so it is not seen from farther

Sweetgum_Lite.done: At the page camera the tree reads as one straight central leader with an open, narrow crown, taller than wide. Its leaves are coarser and fewer, so many copies stay cheap. Every limb sits on its parent and every leaf on its shoot.

view.why: the copy for a backdrop row of many trees, about four tree heights away, where a coarser leaf no longer shows
view.farthest_why: an estimate from how it is used, to be confirmed: the far end of the backdrop row of many trees seen from the scene's camera; the README says only where the row begins
